turns.content: Seeding a two-page PDF into the VFS and rasterizing it at 72 DPI.

arguments.command: mkdir -p /workspace/pdftest; cd /workspace/pdftest; echo '' | base64 -d > doc.pdf; file doc.pdf; pdftoppm -png -r 72 doc.pdf page; ls

turns.content: Done. Wrote page-1.png and page-2.png at 72 DPI.
Rasterizing page 1 only, at 144 DPI, into a single file.
Rasterizing page 2 as a JPEG at the default resolution.

arguments.command: cd /workspace/pdftest; pdftoppm -jpeg -jpegopt quality=80 -f 2 -singlefile doc.pdf cover; ls
